canonical_claim: For a sufficiently differentiable unit-speed curve alpha in oriented Euclidean three-space at every point where its curvature kappa is positive, define T = alpha', N = T' / kappa, B = T cross N, and torsion tau = -<B', N>. Then the orthonormal Frenet frame satisfies T' = kappa N, N' = -kappa T + tau B, and B' = -tau N.
